name: video-knowledge-studio
description: Turn a knowledge gap into sourced animated courses and synchronized study notes.

interface.shortDescription: 按需生成有来源的视频课程
interface.longDescription: Plan a work, research or project knowledge gap, find multiple Bilibili or YouTube explanations, integrate them into a sourced animated course, and create synchronized notes for contextual AI tutoring.
capabilities: Discover and compare multiple Bilibili or YouTube sources
Integrate sources into remix, course or scipop videos
Create synchronized notes, evidence and knowledge networks
Explain selected notes with contextual AI
defaultPrompt: Use Video Knowledge Studio to turn my project knowledge gap into a sourced animated course and study notes.
Plan what I should learn, find complementary Bilibili and YouTube explanations, and build the learning workspace.
